title: status
description: UXP-only. What the plugin reports about itself: host, versions, the bundle protocol, whether a command is running and which project is open. No CEP equivalent (the CEP bridge reports through its heartbeat file).

project.description: active project path or null; native OS path; adapters strip the Windows \\?\ long-path prefix

readback.description: UXP plugin status. host: 'premiere' or 'aftereffects'; hostVersion: the host app version; bundle: the plugin bundle version; protocol: the contract protocol the bundle speaks (the engine refuses a mismatch with its own PROTOCOL); busy: a command is running; project: active project path or null.
